review_locator: PMCID:PMC6120701, The Common Cytokine Receptor gamma Chain Family of Cytokines; PMCID:PMC3981547, Structural Biology of Shared Cytokine Receptors
primary_title: Structure of the human interleukin-7/interleukin-7 receptor alpha complex; Structural basis for interleukin-7 receptor assembly and activation
decision_basis: The reviews identify IL-7Ralpha as the ligand-binding subunit of the IL-7 receptor, and the cited primary studies resolve the IL-7/IL-7Ralpha interface and receptor conformational features.
limitations_preserved: Direct IL-7/IL-7Ralpha binary-binding edge only; the complete IL2RG-containing signaling complex is not claimed as solved by these sources.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6120701, The Common Cytokine Receptor gamma Chain Family of Cytokines; PMCID:PMC3828627, The interleukin-9 receptor and signaling review
primary_title: The common gamma chain is essential for interleukin-9 receptor function; Functional analysis of the interleukin-9 receptor: activation of Jak kinases and Stat proteins and prevention of apoptosis
decision_basis: The reviews describe IL-9Ralpha heteromerization with the common gamma chain and the cited primary studies show IL-9-dependent JAK/STAT activation and proliferative or survival responses.
limitations_preserved: Bounded IL-9 receptor-complex-to-STAT program; preserve shared-gamma-chain assembly and do not infer a single STAT as universal or an SCI glial branch.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6120701, The Common Cytokine Receptor gamma Chain Family of Cytokines; PMCID:PMC3981547, Structural Biology of Shared Cytokine Receptors
primary_title: Crystal structure of the IL-15-IL-15Ralpha complex; The high-affinity IL-15 receptor alpha chain is a key component for trans-presentation
decision_basis: The reviews identify IL-15Ralpha as the high-affinity IL-15-binding subunit, and the cited primary studies resolve the IL-15/IL-15Ralpha structure and high-affinity binding/cis-trans presentation properties.
limitations_preserved: Direct high-affinity IL-15/IL-15Ralpha edge; preserve soluble versus membrane IL-15Ralpha and trans-presentation topology.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6120701, The Common Cytokine Receptor gamma Chain Family of Cytokines; PMCID:PMC3981547, Structural Biology of Shared Cytokine Receptors
primary_title: Structure of the quaternary complex of interleukin-15, its alpha receptor, and the IL-2 receptor beta and gamma chains; Characterization of the human interleukin-15 receptor alpha chain
decision_basis: The reviews describe the quaternary IL-15 receptor as IL-15/IL-15Ralpha/IL-2Rbeta/common-gamma, and the cited primary studies support the assembled receptor architecture and IL-15Ralpha-dependent presentation context.
limitations_preserved: Quaternary receptor-assembly edge only; preserve IL-15 trans-presentation and do not infer a unique downstream adaptor from the extracellular structure.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6120701, The Common Cytokine Receptor gamma Chain Family of Cytokines; PMCID:PMC3981547, Structural Biology of Shared Cytokine Receptors
primary_title: Crystal structure of the IL-21 receptor bound to IL-21; Structural basis for the recognition of the common gamma chain by cytokine receptors
decision_basis: The reviews identify IL-21R as the ligand-binding receptor subunit, and the cited primary studies resolve IL-21/IL-21R binding and map ligand interactions with the common gamma-chain receptor system.
limitations_preserved: Direct IL-21/IL-21R binding edge only; preserve the separate IL2RG co-receptor requirement for signaling and do not transfer IL-21 to IL-4 receptor semantics.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6120701, The Common Cytokine Receptor gamma Chain Family of Cytokines; PMCID:PMC3981547, Structural Biology of Shared Cytokine Receptors
primary_title: Structural blueprint of the IL-21/IL-21R/gammac ternary complex; The common gamma chain is indispensable for IL-21 receptor complex formation and signaling
decision_basis: The reviews describe IL-21R/IL2RG as the signaling receptor complex, and the cited primary studies support ternary receptor assembly and gamma-chain-dependent JAK/STAT signaling competence.
limitations_preserved: Bounded IL-21R/IL2RG complex-to-JAK/STAT competence; preserve receptor-reconstituted context and do not infer a CNS/SCI receiver branch.
